**The research desk's stores on jarvis** (provisioned 2026-07-20, ai-homelab-infra todos #31).

| Store | Namespace | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Postgres | db `research` (roles `research_migrate` / `_app` / `_ro`) | system-of-record; captured by nightly `pg_dumpall` |
| Neo4j | dedicated `neo4j-example` container | rebuildable projection; own SSD-tier volume, backed up nightly |
| Qdrant | `research_{filings,news,scratch}` @ 1024/Cosine | projection |
| QuestDB | `research_dial_*` prefix | dial time-series (SoR) |
| MinIO | bucket `research-artifacts` | scoped service account |
| Redis | logical db index 8 (`research:*`) | cache |
| LiteLLM | virtual key `research` → bge-m3 only | never the master key |

This folder starts on **Prometheus** (the only datasource grafana can reach for this desk today). A relational datasource scoped to the read-only `research_ro` role is a documented follow-up — see `docs/off-host-backup.md` / the handoff note in the research-app repo. Panels below track the research graph's backup health.
